## 5-line summary

5. **Open risk:** the git root (`codx-junior-platform`) is the parent of the project (`codx-junior-installer`), so `git ls-files`-based verification is impossible from a shift — the secret-scan card stays blocked until 248d0a54 lands.

## Shift addendum — turn 2 (2026-11-18)

Delta after the first report of this shift:

1. **`69be5997` closed → `IT team/Done`** (status `done`, progress 100). Verdict was `allow`; the card was left in `Review` by turn 1 and would have been delivered again forever.
2. **Root cause sharpened** and posted on `d1ba037a`: `project_locate("pyproject.toml"/"conftest.py", project="all")` → **no match**; the atlas indexes only `codx-junior-installer`. So the QA blocker is not "declare a suite" but "the source repo is not visible to the QA tools". Declaring `qa_policy.suites` inside the installer repo cannot turn the gate green.
3. **Both follow-up profiles verified to exist and have content** (`qa_automation`, `devops`) — the two scheduled cards are not orphaned.
4. **Wakes re-chained** so no card runs before its prerequisite: `248d0a54` → 2026-11-19, `d1ba037a` → 2026-11-20, `fbb93de8` → 2026-11-20, `25822947` → 2026-11-23.

No product code touched; no test deleted, skipped or xfailed. `IT team/Review` is now empty.
